estimand: target local share among valid party votes conditional only on source local share and source/target nationwide valid-party shares
units: shares fractions; reported errors percentage points
futureInputContract: 2023-on-2026 supported as bounds; never scored or predicted in Stage5
eligibility: existing panel canonical identity, unique source/target match,0<P0,P1<1; entrants/exits/ambiguous excluded without fake zeros
aggregation: Report general and Maori separately; aggregate records equally then macro-average canonical-party MAEs; vote weighting uses actual target party votes. Transition is validation cluster, no random split. Quantiles use linear interpolation.
uncertainty: Monotone propagation of Stage4 outer share bounds; retain attainable extremum brackets and numerical gaps separately; aggregate lower/upper loss summaries are conservative marginal enclosures, not jointly attainable realizations. No midpoint.
selectionGuard: If materially conflicting winners or robustness ordering can reverse, retain unresolved candidate set; no automatic winner from one aggregate.
antiLeakage: No candidate effects or person linking
limitations: Only three primary transition clusters; seven Maori electorates per election
National target support is conditioning information, not a national forecast
Synthetic geographic intervals are coupled; aggregate marginal bounds may be loose
